reviewer: Independent original-pixel, mapped-reference and official-source reviewer
scope: Narrow rear-right questioner repair in mm-john-questions-v2.

entries.alt: John the Baptist listens to a man speaking with open hands beside a river, while an older man waits behind him.
entries.caption: People bring John a practical question about how to live. His answers turn repentance toward sharing, honesty and the fair treatment of others.
entries.findings: Direct comparison with rejected original and mapped birth-john-witness actual pixels. John retains distinctive narrower face, prominent nose, short beard, camel-hair clothing, staff and attentive gaze. Primary questioner retains face, open hands and eye contact. Rear-right man now has short gray hair, broad lined clean-shaven face, different nose and brow; duplicate identity is resolved. Natural photographic skin and age detail; composition, river, clothing, gestures and participants visually preserved outside intended face/hair repair. No literal Christ.
conditions: Keep listeners unnamed; do not assign either pictured man a publican or soldier identity that is not visually established. Exact staging, garment detail and location are interpretation.
Preserve original rejected candidate and prior review85; this acceptance applies only to the v2 SHA-256.
